description: Reviewed native residue for scripts/check_build_flag_leaks.py. For each executable (by file name) and disabled flag, 'artifacts' maps the exact text around each match (up to 60 characters either side) to how many times it may occur. A new or changed string fails the gate even when another one was removed. Record new matches with --record-residue, review them and keep docs/build-flags.md in step. Each flag needs a reason.

reasons.GEMINI: Residual Gemini names in shared native code that every build compiles: settings and state field names, launch and import diagnostics, model catalogues, environment variable names and C++ symbol names. Source lists, bridge routes, id tables and folder reads are gated; removing the rest needs provider-adapter and state-schema work (Build Flag Complete Removal follow-up in the V5 change log and docs/build-flags.md).
